name: What is the process for getting a wheelchair ramp installed by City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a wheelchair ramp installed by City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your needs, assess your property, and recommend suitable ramp options. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal and estimate. Once approved, we handle any necessary permits with local authorities in your Bay Area city (e.g., San Mateo or Redwood City). Our skilled team then proceeds with the professional installation, adhering to all safety standards and building codes. We conclude with a final inspection to ensure your complete satisfaction and proper functionality of the ramp.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, property assessment, proposal, permit handling, professional installation, and a final inspection to ensure satisfaction.
